title: Picks store module: addPick / removePick / listPicks over localStorage
goal: Write the picks store. Export exactly these functions: listPicks(): string[] (the picked book ids, in the order they were added), addPick(id: string): void (adds it; adding an id that is already there does nothing), removePick(id: string): void. Keep the ids in localStorage under the key "picks" as a JSON array of strings.
spec:
There is no backend and no sign-in: the books come from the fixture file, the member's picks and loans live in the browser (localStorage).

PCK-2: The page at `/picks` ... lists each picked book with its title and author and a button "Remove <title>" that takes it off the list.

PCK-6: The picks are kept when the page is reloaded.
